name: Measure electricity
summary: Multimeters sit forgotten in car repair shops, HVAC vans, school labs and makerspaces; looters walk right past them. With no meter, a 12V bulb or an LED with a resistor makes a test lamp, and a known resistor lets you work out current. Many chargers, power stations and solar controllers have a voltage display built in.

parts.why: Shunts and dividers for measuring current and voltage
LED test lamps show power is present
Voltage displays from chargers and controllers
A steady 2.5V reference to check a meter against

tips: Never measure current straight across a battery. The meter becomes a short.
Current in amps = volts across a known resistor ÷ its ohms.
Check the meter on a known battery before you trust a reading of zero.
Cheap meters can fail dangerously on mains. Stay on low voltage unless the meter is rated for it.
